QuestInfo.name: Not Ready to Go Home Yet
QuestInfo.1: #p401# of #m10003000# accepted #p402#'s gift with an air of indifference, but seemed secretly pleased deep down. I should go let #p402# know. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p402# seemed happy to hear that #p401# had secretly liked the gift. It seems #p402# has learned a lot during his time here in #m10003000#.

0.0: #p402#, still remembering something from all the way back then, huh? Guess you weren't such a hopeless case after all. Hah! Honestly, I'd completely forgotten about it myself until just now.
0.1: Eh, who knows. Back then, I just saw something in that kid's eyes — starving, flat broke, collapsed on the ground — that told me he wasn't the type to give up. All I did was give a little push on the back of someone who clearly had what it takes to survive in this world.
0.2: Tell him not to overthink it — just being part of this city now is proof enough that he's made it, all on their own. Hah!

yes.0: Hm? What was inside the gift box? Hah! Nothing in this world comes free. Pay the right price, and maybe I'll tell you.

1.0: You're back! Did you deliver my gift to #p401# alright? Did he say anything else?
1.1: I see. Man, back then I was so starving and worn out, but the moment I saw his face, I just thought, I can't die here. Tch... That guy's always acting like some kind of older brother. He just casually says the exact thing you need to hear to feel better, without even trying — makes me feel like I'll never be able to keep up with him, no matter how long I live.
1.2: Guess I can't just head back to #m10001000# like this after all. I'm going to earn my place as a proper member of this city first, and go back with my head held high. Thanks for all your help up to now!

npc.0: I had no idea #p402# was still thinking about something from that long ago. Turns out he's more sentimental than he looks, hah!
